interpretation_limits: The 13 tasks have already been reviewed and are development-only.
The oracle is reference-informed and cannot be interpreted as a realizable policy.
Anchor coverage is not full semantic answer correctness.
The transparent scores are mechanism probes, not learned retrieval models.
Only two source clusters are represented; task-macro and cluster-macro values are both reported.

metric_definitions.fact_coverage: Fraction of frozen supporting adjudication anchors whose candidate was looked up. Contrast/distractor anchors are recorded separately and do not count as useful facts.
metric_definitions.lookup_cost: Mean number of candidate lookups actually made.
metric_definitions.regret_to_oracle: Oracle task-macro rate minus strategy task-macro rate, floored at zero. The oracle uses reference labels and is only an upper bound.
metric_definitions.sufficient_set_discovery: The looked-up set contains at least one frozen minimal sufficient set. For ESD_010, cand_003 alone is sufficient; cand_007 is optional redundant support.

scientific_scope: Frozen finite-panel simulation of evidence-check ordering. It is not a model effect, natural experiment, deployed-agent result, or independent-generalization claim.
